quarterly_data.quarter: Microchip Technology press release: Microchip's 1.2V Clock Buffers Link Latest SoCs and FPGAs (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Microchip introduced the SY757xx family of 1.2V-output LVCMOS clock buffers for FinFET-based FPGAs, SoCs, AI accelerators and next-generation CPUs: three products in production and eight sampling in limited volumes, covering 0 Hz to 250 MHz, 1.2V to 3.3V voltage-translation inputs and additive jitter as low as 26 femtoseconds. The SY75707TWL-TR, SY75712TWL-TR and SY75714TWL-TR are in volume production, priced from $0.50 to $0.83 per unit in volumes of 10,000.
quarterly_data.figure: three products in production, eight sampling; additive jitter as low as 26 femtoseconds; $0.50 to $0.83 per unit in volumes of 10,000
